why: I checked both must_not items, and neither one shows up in the briefs. Item 1: the builder brief does wrap `JSON.parse` in a try/catch, but only to rethrow. It says to "throw a new error whose `message` includes the path", and it warns against returning a value: "Do NOT catch the error and return `{}` or defaults". So it never tells the builder to return a value on a parse error. Item 2: verifier Check 2 accepts line 3 and column 3 "in any readable form (for example `line 3 column 3` or `3:3`)". It fails a run only if a required item is missing or the line or column isn't 3. Its path check needs the exact path string, which the expect line requires, and it doesn't fix a format or an order. The builder's "Example format" is only an example and doesn't bind the verifier.
